rationale: WorkOS documents its own feature for letting end users connect their third-party accounts, and a data-providers widget API that connects or disconnects the authenticated user's own accounts. This points to a first-party delegated third-party connection capability. The evidence never shows an agent retrieving short-lived access tokens from those connections, nor how tool calls run under that delegated authority. Vault only encrypts and stores data, so it does not count as a consent-based token exchange. missing for 10: documented retrieval of short-lived, refreshed third-party access tokens by agents, an explicit user-consent/OAuth grant flow per provider, agent/tool-call integration guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
